titre: Practice test — English (4th year primary, first year) — Term 1

exercices.enonce:
Greetings. Complete the dialogue with: Hello - name - fine - bye.
1) - .......... ! Good morning.
2) - What is your ..........? - My name is Nour.
3) - How are you? - I am .........., thank you.
4) - Goodbye! - .......... !

exercices.enonce:
Numbers 1-10.
1) Put the numbers in order: (2 points)
four - one - three - two
-> ...., ...., ...., ....
2) Write in letters: (3 points)
4 = ..........   7 = ..........   9 = ..........

exercices.enonce:
The alphabet.
1) Write the missing letters: (3 points)
h, ...., j, ...., l, ....
2) Circle the letter that comes before: (2 points)
- before d: ( b / c / e )
- before r: ( p / q / s )

Colours and classroom objects.
1) Match the colour to the object: (3 points)
a) The sky is ....... .
b) Grass is ....... .
c) A ripe tomato is ....... .
( green - blue - red )
2) Complete: (2 points)
I read a b .... .... k.   I write with a p .... n.
